import re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup, NavigableString, MarkupResemblesLocatorWarning
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore', category=MarkupResemblesLocatorWarning)


def clean_text_spacing(text: str) -> str:
    """Clean up text spacing issues from HTML extraction.
    
    Args:
        text: Text extracted from HTML that may have spacing issues
        
    Returns:
        Cleaned text with proper spacing
    """
    if not text:
        return text
    
    # Normalize multiple spaces to single space
    text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)
    
    # Fix domain names: remove space before period followed by domain extension
    # Examples: "weather .com" -> "weather.com", "example .org" -> "example.org"
    text = re.sub(r'\s+\.([a-zA-Z]{2,})\b', r'.\1', text)
    
    # Fix www/http/https patterns
    # Examples: "www .example" -> "www.example"
    text = re.sub(r'\b(www|http|https)\s+\.', r'\1.', text)
    
    # Fix spaces before common punctuation
    text = re.sub(r'\s+([,;:])', r'\1', text)
    
    # Strip leading/trailing whitespace
    return text.strip()


def remove_tags(soup: BeautifulSoup, tag_names: list) -> None:
    """Remove specified tags from the soup.
    
    Args:
        soup: BeautifulSoup object to modify
        tag_names: List of tag names to remove
    """
    for tag_name in tag_names:
        for tag in soup.find_all(tag_name):
            tag.decompose()


def replace_tags(soup: BeautifulSoup, from_tag: str, to_tag: str) -> None:
    """Replace one tag with another while preserving content.
    
    Args:
        soup: BeautifulSoup object to modify
        from_tag: Tag to replace
        to_tag: New tag name
    """
    for tag in soup.find_all(from_tag):
        new_tag = soup.new_tag(to_tag)
        new_tag.attrs = tag.attrs.copy()
        new_tag.extend(tag.contents)
        tag.replace_with(new_tag)


def extract_text_with_spacing(soup: BeautifulSoup) -> str:
    """Extract text from HTML preserving appropriate spacing.
    
    Args:
        soup: BeautifulSoup object to extract text from
        
    Returns:
        Cleaned text with proper spacing
    """
    # Clone the soup to avoid modifying the original
    clone = BeautifulSoup(str(soup), 'html.parser')
    
    # Remove script and style elements
    for tag in clone.find_all(['script', 'style']):
        tag.decompose()
    
    # Get text with space preservation
    text = clone.get_text(separator=' ', strip=True)
    
    return clean_text_spacing(text)
